why: Khalil et al. (Axioms, Sept 2024) claimed a proof of the invariant subspace problem for separable Hilbert spaces, a case of the stated problem; Ghatasheh's Nov 2024 arXiv preprint refutes it, identifying a specific false step. A claim-and-withdrawal within the window counts per the instructions even though the problem remains open.
